author: Mindy
body:
Hello ^^ I’m pretty bad at PVP and completely inferior to my friend Rivzz (he’s cool ig and you should ask him if he ate dinner yet). However, the community here seemed pretty cool and I became sorta addicted to coming on, oops. So… My name is Mindy. I started playing minecraft again about three(?) weeks ago after taking a break for three years. I usually like to come on around 9 pm (PST) on the daily, but may occasionally come on earlier. It’s kinda empty around then, but it’s still fun. I live in California and it’s gr8 man. I’m turning 16 soon so I’m old.


I don’t know, let me know if you want to rekt me at PVP. Also there’s this “AMA” thing you young folks are doing, so I’ll do that too.


lmao k bye <33
